brief:
Publishers for Palestine will hold Read Palestine Week from November 29 to December 5, 2026, marking the fourth iteration of an annual event launched in 2023. The week combines reading and resistance activities as part of the collective's ongoing efforts to promote Palestinian literature and culture.

The event has grown annually since its founding three years ago, drawing readers and supporters interested in Palestinian voices and publishing.
dek: November 29-December 5 will be the fourth annual Read Palestine Week, a week of reading and resistance that began in 2023, founded and organized by the collective Publishers for Palestine.
title: Publishers for Palestine organize fourth annual Read Palestine Week
